Also: `OnSceneLoaded` (buildIndex>1) sets `PlayerLoaded`/`PlayerLevel` props and calls `CreatedOrJoinedRoom()` again. `OnPlayerLeftRoom`→`SpawnPointManager.HandlePlayerLeftRoom` releases spawn points.

### Flow 2 — Ready System
```
LobbyCanvas.OnStartClicked()  (start button; UI/Framework/Canvas/LobbyCanvas.cs:~670)
  ├─ guard: IsStayLobby && !isReady
  ├─ RuneEquipmentSnapshot.CaptureFrom(runePanel)
  ├─ gameActionChannel.Raise(GameActionType.SyncAllPlayers)   → PlayerManager/TeamUIManager refresh
  ├─ isReady = true; disable start button
  └─ gameActionChannel.Raise(GameActionType.SetLocalReady)
        ↓
GameManager.OnGameActionReceived(actionType)  (Managers/GameManager.cs:220, registered listener on gameActionChannel)
  └─ case SetLocalReady → NetworkServiceLocator.GameActionService.SetLocalReady(true)
        ↓ (IGameActionService; EarlyGameActionService delegates to Launcher.instance, later Launcher's own impl)
Launcher.SetLocalReady(true)  →  _sceneFlow.SetLocalReady(true)
        ↓
NetworkSceneFlow.SetLocalReady(ready)
  ├─ PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer.SetCustomProperties({Ready: ready})
  ├─ PhotonPlayerService.NotifyPropertyChanged(localActor, "PlayerReady", ready)  [local UI update]
  └─ CheckAllPlayersReady()
        ├─ AllPlayersReady()  [loops PhotonNetwork.PlayerList checking PlayerPropertyKeys.Ready]
        └─ if all ready → isRoomLoading=true → StartCoroutine(LoadLevelAfterDelay(2))
              ├─ wait 2s → Loading.Instance.Show()
              └─ if IsMasterClient → PhotonNetwork.LoadLevel(2)
```
Cross-client propagation: the `Ready` property change → `Launcher.OnPlayerPropertiesUpdate` → `_sceneFlow.CheckAllPlayersReady()` (each client independently evaluates). Also `PhotonCallbackBridge.OnPlayerPropertiesUpdate` → `PhotonPlayerService.NotifyPropertyChanged` → `OnPlayerPropertyChanged` event. `ResetLocalReady`/`ResetForLobby` reset state on scene load.

### Flow 3 — RPC Bridge Flow
```
Domain layer (e.g. SyncedGameTimeManager, SpiderBoss caller)
  └─ NetworkServiceLocator.DomainRpcService.InvokeRPC("RPC_SyncStartCaTime", NetworkTarget.All, params)
        ↓ (IDomainRpcService, impl = DomainRpcBridge)
DomainRpcBridge.InvokeRPC(methodName, target, parameters)
  ├─ guard: photonView != null
  └─ photonView.RPC(methodName, NetworkTargetMapper.ToRpcTarget(target), parameters)
        ↓ NetworkTargetMapper: All→RpcTarget.All, Others→RpcTarget.Others, MasterClient→RpcTarget.MasterClient, AllBuffered→RpcTarget.AllBuffered
        ↓ (Photon network transport)
[PunRPC] handler on DomainRpcBridge (executes on target client(s))
  └─ delegates to Domain object's static Handle* method:
       • RPC_SyncStartCaTime → SyncedGameTimeManager.HandleSyncStartCaTime()
       • RPC_SyncPlayerTarget(targetViewID) → GetSpiderBoss().HandleSyncPlayerTarget(viewID)
       • RPC_InitElementPool(viewID,element) → ObjectService.FindByViewID → WizardBoy.HandleInitElementPool
       • RPC_PlayTriggerAnimation(viewID,trigger) → ObjectService.FindByViewID → BallRobot_Blue.HandlePlayTriggerAnimation
       • RPC_RequestEnemyDestroy(viewID) → ObjectService.FindByViewID → PhotonNetwork.Destroy
       (etc.)
```
The 3 bridges (`AppRpcBridge`/`DomainRpcBridge`/`PresentationRpcBridge`) are created by `InfrastructureRegistrar` at `BeforeSceneLoad` with fresh `PhotonView`s (ViewID=0); `PhotonCallbackBridge.OnJoinedRoom` → `AllocateBridgeViewIDs()` assigns real ViewIDs so they can send/receive RPCs. `PhotonObjectService.InvokeRPC` follows the same mapping path for arbitrary source MonoBehaviours.

### Flow 4 — Damage Flow
```
ImpactCannon.OnTriggerEnter(other)  (Controllers/Combat/ImpactCannon.cs)
  ├─ guard: other.CompareTag("Enemy") && _isMyCast (local player's projectile owns damage)
  ├─ damage = attributePlayer.GetAttackPower() * damageFalloff
  ├─ isCritical = Random <= GetCriticalChance()
  └─ (non-test) _networkCaster.BroadcastDamage(other.gameObject, damage, isCritical, critMult, hitPoint, element)
        ↓  (CastNetwork = INetworkFireballCaster broadcaster)
CastNetwork.BroadcastDamage(enemyObj, damage, isCritical, critMult, hitPoint, element)
  ├─ enemyView = enemyObj.GetComponent<PhotonView>()
  ├─ photonView.RPC("RPC_DealDamage", RpcTarget.All, enemyView.ViewID, damage, isCritical, critMult, hitPoint, (int)element)
  └─ photonView.RPC("RPC_ShowDamageNum", RpcTarget.All, damage, hitPoint, isCritical, critMult)
        ↓ (Photon; executes on ALL clients)
[PunRPC] CastNetwork.RPC_DealDamage(enemyViewID, damage, isCritical, critMult, hitPoint, elementInt)
  ├─ enemyView = PhotonView.Find(enemyViewID)
  ├─ args = DamageEventArgs.GetShared(element, gameObject(attacker), enemyView.gameObject(target), damage, isCritical, critMult)
  └─ EventChannelLocator.MainContainer.damageEventChannel.Raise(args)
        ↓  (DamageEventChannelSO : BaseEventChannelSO<DamageEventArgs>)
        ↓  notifies all registered listeners
EnemyBase.OnDamageReceived(args)  (Controllers/Enemy/EnemyBase.cs:402 — damageEventChannel.RegisterListener(OnDamageReceived) in Awake)
  └─ validates damageTarget == gameObject (dedup, since RpcTarget.All makes every EnemyBase instance receive the event but only the matching target processes it) → applies HP reduction
```
Test-mode shortcut: `ImpactCannon.DealDamageLocal` raises `damageEventChannel` directly (no RPC). Split bullets are broadcast via `CastNetwork.RequestSplitBullet` → `RPC_OnSplitBulletCast` → `SpawnSplitBulletForOthers` (isMine=false, visual only).

---

## Architecture Summary
The architecture uses a layered RPC-bridge pattern decoupled via `NetworkServiceLocator` interfaces:
- **Bootstrap**: `InfrastructureRegistrar` (BeforeSceneLoad) → registers `PhotonPlayerService`+`PhotonObjectService` into `NetworkServiceLocator`, runs `GameServiceRegistrar` (early lightweight `IObjectPoolService`/`IGameActionService`), creates 3 RPC bridges + `PhotonCallbackBridge`, registers component factories.
- **RPC layering**: 3 singletons (`AppRpcBridge` Application, `DomainRpcBridge` Domain, `PresentationRpcBridge` Presentation) each hold all `[PunRPC]` methods for their layer and do pure forwarding to Domain/Application static `Handle*` methods — eliminating direct Photon dependencies in business code. Domain layer sends RPCs via `IDomainRpcService.InvokeRPC` → `NetworkTargetMapper` → `photonView.RPC`.
- **Callback forwarding**: `PhotonCallbackBridge` (separate from `Launcher`'s own `MonoBehaviourPunCallbacks`) routes PUN player events to `PhotonPlayerService` C# events, and allocates ViewIDs for the bridges. `Launcher` itself handles room/scene/property callbacks and delegates to `SpawnPointManager` (spawn logic) + `NetworkSceneFlow` (ready/scene logic).
- **Damage decoupling**: damage travels via `RpcTarget.All` RPC → `DamageEventArgs` → `damageEventChannel` ScriptableObject event → `EnemyBase` listener (with target-self dedup), so combat code is event-driven rather than directly coupled.

## Architecture Summary
The architecture uses a layered RPC-bridge pattern decoupled via `NetworkServiceLocator` interfaces:
- **Bootstrap**: `InfrastructureRegistrar` (BeforeSceneLoad) → registers `PhotonPlayerService`+`PhotonObjectService` into `NetworkServiceLocator`, runs `GameServiceRegistrar` (early lightweight `IObjectPoolService`/`IGameActionService`), creates 3 RPC bridges + `PhotonCallbackBridge`, registers component factories.

Domain layer sends RPCs via `IDomainRpcService.InvokeRPC` → `NetworkTargetMapper` → `photonView.RPC`.
- **Callback forwarding**: `PhotonCallbackBridge` (separate from `Launcher`'s own `MonoBehaviourPunCallbacks`) routes PUN player events to `PhotonPlayerService` C# events, and allocates ViewIDs for the bridges. `Launcher` itself handles room/scene/property callbacks and delegates to `SpawnPointManager` (spawn logic) + `NetworkSceneFlow` (ready/scene logic).
- **Damage decoupling**: damage travels via `RpcTarget.All` RPC → `DamageEventArgs` → `damageEventChannel` ScriptableObject event → `EnemyBase` listener (with target-self dedup), so combat code is event-driven rather than directly coupled.
